title: Feature with validation and hidden tests (Python stdlib)
prompt: Ticket PAY-31: `money.parse_amount` uses float and accepts anything. Rewrite it so that it returns a `decimal.Decimal` rounded to 2 places (half up) and accepts amounts with an optional currency symbol ($ or ₡), thousands separators as commas and surrounding spaces, e.g. "1250.5", "1,250.50", " $1,250.50 ", "₡3,000". It must raise `ValueError` for empty text, negative amounts, letters or malformed numbers such as "1,2,3" or "12.3.4". Add unit tests for the accepted and rejected cases, run the checks and finish.
